summary: Selects the output shape for Stability text-to-image and single-reference control requests. All reviewed values target roughly one megapixel, so changing the ratio redistributes pixels between width and height instead of selecting a separate resolution tier.
combines: The control applies to text-to-image on both transports and to direct Stability style or structure control requests.
It is omitted for direct style transfer and Bedrock image-to-image requests because the source image defines the frame.
The synchronized default is 1:1. The model matrix validates the selected value against this exact nine-value list before provider execution.

usage.code: STABILITY_IMAGE_CONTROLS publishes imageSize; the provider sends aspect_ratio only on routes where Stability accepts it
usage.from: the Stability image model configuration row
usage.what: Shows the Aspect ratio dropdown, persists its value per selected Stability model, validates it in the matrix, and sends it on compatible direct API and Bedrock requests.
